en.name: Eutychian
en.summary: A pope of the later third century whose reign is documented mainly through the barest entries in later papal lists.
en.body: As with several popes of this period, Eutychian's eight years in office fall into a stretch of the papal record where contemporary documentation is extremely thin, and what survives comes almost entirely from the Liber Pontificalis, compiled long after his death. No verified major event of his reign has come down to us.
